answer_raw:
The latest Claude models are **Claude Fable 5.2** and **Claude Mythos 5.2** (undated) [2], which compete with OpenAI's **GPT-6.1 Terra** (2026-10-26) [1].

The comparison between these two model families depends on whether you prioritize raw technical capability or integrated agentic workflows:

**Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2** — These are Anthropic's most capable models for daunting technical work, setting a new bar in coding, finance, and the sciences (undated) [2]. They generate outputs up to **30% faster** than the previous 5.1 versions and are priced at **$8 per million input tokens** and **$s40 per million output tokens** (2026-10-29) [3].

**GPT-6.1 Terra** — This model focuses on delivering **fast and capable computer use** at scale (2026-10-26) [1].

For coding, I would use **Claude Fable 5.2** because it is specifically positioned as a top-tier model for technical work and coding tasks (undated) [2].

| :--- | :--- | :--- |
